Amazon’s early Amazon Prime Day deals are now live alongside a solid price drop on AirPods Pro 3 (or up to $100 off via Amazon Resale – details here) and the return of AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off. Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break aso features the most affordable 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air at $200 off ($400 under the model Amazon sells), the black Apple Watch Ultra 3 at over $200 off and the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 you can buy at up to $160 off via Amazon Resale today. Just be sure to also scope out these official Apple accessory deals from $7.50 – black USB-C and extra MacBook MagSafe 3 cables, plus more. Head below for a closer look.

Early Amazon Prime Day deals now live: AirPods Pro 3, Pixel 10, Ring smart home up to 50% off, more

AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off at Amazon, or up to nearly $100 off ‘like new’

  • Apple AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Or $100 off via Amazon Resale
  • Apple AirPods Max 2 $509 (Reg. $549)

Most affordable current-gen AirPods now nearly 25% off, AirPods Pro 3 deal, more

The early Amazon Prime Day deals are live and along with them we are seeing an ongoing price drop on AirPods Pro 3 (or up to $100 off via Amazon Resale – details here). And we just spotted the most affordable current-gen set dropping back down to $99 at nearly 25% off.

After jumping back up to $119 late yesterday, Amazon is now once again offering AirPods 4 back down at $99 shipped.

Regularly $129, this is not a giant discount or anything but we are talking about a discount approaching 25% off the list on what is already the most affordable set of current-gen Apple AirPods you can buy.

As we explained last go around, there were some wild price drops on these buds for Black Friday and the holidays last year, but today’s deal delivers a deal price on par with the lowest we have tracked in 2026 thus far.

There is, of course, a chance we see them drop down to $79 or $89 come Prime Day later this month, but the only time we have seen them go for any less than that was during Black Friday last year. Prime Day 2025 had them at $89, or just $10 lower than we are seeing right now.

Most affordable 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air at $200 off ($400 under the model Amazon sells)

Amazon has bumped the prices back up on much of the new M5 MacBook Air configs. It is still offering the 16GB/1TB 15-inch model at $200 off (Amazon low), but we also wanted to highlight this deal on the most affordable 15-inch 24GB model you can buy.

The only 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air Amazon sells has 1TB of storage and a price tag to match. Over at authorized dealer B&H however, you can score the 24GB machine at with 512GB of storage though at a much lower price and this machine is available for purchase at $200 off right now.

B&H is offering the Midnight 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and 512GB of storage at $1,299 shipped. This machine carries a $1,499 list price from Apple and is not available at Best Buy or Amazon.

You’re not only saving $200 here, but you’re also landing the most affordable 15-inch M5 Air with 24GB of RAM.

This is $400 under the regular price on the 24GB machine Amazon sells (although it is $150 off right now). Yes, the Amazon config does have double the storage, but if you’re anything like me you would rather pay for the RAM than the storage and this machine nets you a mid-range RAM upgrade at the lowest possible price.

B&H also still has a couple other particularly notable 15-inch MacBook Air configs in stock right now at up to $270 off with official Apple charger upgrades worth an extra $20 right now too:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
  • With 70W USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)

Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 is over $200 off via Amazon Resale today

Deals on the latest Apple Watch Ultra 3 remain mostly hard to come by. We have seen a couple chances to land them at $99 off, but that’s about it. However, right now, courtesy of Amazon Resale, we are seeing the regularly $799 flagship wearable down as low as $588 with a one size fits all band in the all-black colorway.

Amazon Resale is now offering the black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the matching black Ocean Band down at $587.57 shipped in “Used – Like New” condition.

This is a regular $799 Ultra 3 configuration at $211 off the list price to deliver one of the better deals we have tracked to date. Yes it is an Amazon Resale listing, but it is one shipped and sold by Amazon at more than double the best deals we have tracked on brand new units thus far.

As mentioned above, deals on the Ultra 3 have been rare at best. Currently starting at $779 or $20 off the list, we are yet to see this configuration with the black Ocean Band (or any other standard $799 config for that matter) sell for under $699 since release in late 2025.

There is a chance we see this $99 discount return for Prime Day later this month, and potentially something a touch better, but it’s hard to say for sure. Something close to $699 is certainly possible and even likely, but anything close to $200 off seems like a major stretch at this point.
